shortDescription: Retrieves details for a specified OpenStack flavor.

options.name: cloud
options.description: A dictionary containing authentication and connection parameters for the destination OpenStack cloud. This should include details like C(auth_url), C(username), C(password), C(project_name), C(user_domain_name), C(project_domain_name), C(region_name), etc., or a C(cloud) key to use a clouds.yaml profile.

options.name: flavor_name
options.description: The name or the UUID of the OpenStack flavor to retrieve.
